plugins.name: relex-legal
plugins.description: Relex legal practice management for Claude: work on your Relex matters over a PII-safe MCP connector (twelve tools: ten matter tools plus search and execute). Party identities are sealed with a key only the user holds, documents are read and redacted by the Relex Private Model, and the assistant works with de-identified labels.
